verses.text:
\s1 Jesus Khazih Khangthu  
\r Lk 3:23-28
Abraham le David i suan ahi, Jesus Christ i khang thu sia hibang a hihi.
Abraham tapa Isaac; Isaac tapa Jacob; Jacob tapa Judah le a suapuite;
Judah le Tamar tapa te Perez le Zerah, Perez ta Hezron; Hezron tapa Aram,
Aram tapa Amminadab; Amminadab tapa Nahshon; Nahshon tapa Salmon;
Salmon tapa Boaz hi; Boaz i nu Rahab; Boaz tapa Obed; Obed nu Ruth; Obed tapa Jesse;
Jesse tapa David Kumpipa; David kumpipa tapa Solomon; a nu sia Uriah i zi hi ngei hi.
Solomon tapa Roboam; Roboam tapa Abijah; Abijah tapa Asa;
Asa tapa Jehoshaphat; Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram; Jehoram ta Uzziah;
Uzziah ta Jotham; Jotham ta Ahaz; Ahaz ta Hezekiah;
Hezekiah ta Manasseh; Manasseh ta Amon; Amon tapa Josiah;
Josiah ta Jechoniah, Jechoniah in Babylon khua ah a ki khin ma a nei a suapui te;
Babylon a ki khin zawkciang Jechoniah tapa Shealtiel; Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel;
Zerubbabel ta Abiud; Abiud ta Eliakim; Eliakim ta Azor;
Azor ta Zadok; Zadok ta Achim; Achim ta Elihud;
Elihud ta Eleazar; Eleazar ta Matthan; Matthan ta Jacob;
Jacob ta Joseph; Joseph sia Mary i pasal hi a, Mary sung pan Christ a kici Jesus hong suak hi.

Tua ahikom Abraham pan in David dong khang sawm le khang li hi a; David pan in Babylon ah a ki khin dong khang sawm le khang li; Babylon a ki khin pan in Christ ciang dong khang sawm le khang li a hihi.   
\s1 Ngaknu Thiangtho Mary le Jesus  
\r Lk. 1:26-35; Lk. 2:1-7; Jn. 1:1, 2, 14
Jesus Christ sua na thu sia hibang a hihi: A nu Mary sia Joseph in dokzu a piak sa hi a, a ki ngawm khop ma in Tha Thiangtho taw nau ngil om hi.
Joseph sia thutang khat hi a, Mary mindaisak nuam ngawl ahikom, nol ku tu in ngaisun hi.
Tabang a ngaisut laitak in, a mang sungah vantungmi khat hong ki lang a, David suan Joseph awng, Mary na zi tu in tenpui tu lau heak in: banghangziam cile a naungil sia Tha Thiangtho taw a hihi.
Tapa nei tu a, tua tapa in a mite mawna pan ngum tu ahi man in, Jesus ci in a min na phuak tu hi: ci in vantungmi in son hi.
Hi te theampo Pathian in kamsang te tungtawn in a sonkholsa a tangtun na a hihi, kamsang i sonkhol na ah,
En vun, ngaknu thiangtho khat naungil om tu a, tapa khat nei tu hi, a min Immanuel kiphuak tu hi, Emmanuel a khiakna sia, Pathian eite taw hong om hi, ci nopna a hihi.
Joseph a khanlaw ciang, Topa vantungmi i sawl bang in, Mary tenpui hi.
Ahihang taciil a nei dong luppui ngawl a, a min Jesus ci in phuak hi.
Herod Kumpi a sep laitak in, Judah ngam Bethlehem khua ah Jesus a sua ciang in, nisuana sang pan mipil te Jerusalem ah hong theng uh a;
Hong suak Judah te Kumpipa koisung ah om ziam? Nisuana sang panin ama i aksi hong suak ka mu uh a, ama bia tu in hong theng khu hi, ci uh hi.
Herod kumpipa in hi thu a zak ciang in ama le Jerusalem ah a om theampo linglawng ngawp uh hi.
Herod in mipi te sung pan thiampi lian te le thukhamhil sya te kaikhawm in, Christ koisung a suak tu ziam? ci in dong hi.
Taciang amate in, Judah ngam Bethlehem khua ah hi tu hi: banghangziam cile kamsang khat i atkhol na ah,
Judah ngam sung a om, nang Bethlehem awng, Judah ngam uk te sungah a nobel na hi bua hi: banghangziam cile ka mi Israel te a uk tu nang sung pan hong piang tu hi, ci hi.
Tasiaciang Herod kumpipa in mipil te samku a, banghun in aksi suak ziam ci thiangtak in dong hi.
Taciang amate Bethlehem ah paisak a, tua nauno phatak hong zong tavun; Ama na mu uh ciang in hong sonkik tavun, keizong pai in bia tu khi hi, ci hi.
Amate in kumpipa son teng a zak zawk uh ciang pai uh hi; Taciang, en vun, nisuana sang pan a mu uh aksi sia nausen omna tungsan ah theng in a tawlngak dong amate mai ah pai hi.
Amate in tua aksi a mu uh ciang in, nasiatak in lungdam uh hi.
Innsung a tum uh ciang in, a nu Mary le nausen mu uh a, kun in bia tek uh hi: taciang a ken uh na manpha te sua in, kham, frankincense le myrh te pia uh hi.

Tuazawkciang Herod kumpipa kungah heakkik nawnngawl tu in Pathian in amate i mang sungah kidop natu a piak hu in lamdang pan in amate ngam ah cia uh hi.   
\s1 Nausen Egypt Ngam ah Taipui

Amate cia zawkciang, Joseph mang sungah Topa vantungmi hong kilang a, tho in, nausen le a nu keng in, Egypt ngam ah tai vun, thu kong puak kik dong tua ngam ah om nginge vun: banghangziam cile Herod in hi nausen that tu in zong tu hi, ci hi.
Joseph a khanlaw ciang, nausen le a nu keng in, a zan a zan in Egypt ngam ah taipui hi.

Herod kumpipa a thi dong tua ngam ah om uh hi: hi thu sia, ka tapa Egypt ngam pan samkik zo khi hi, ci Topa in kamsang tungtawn in a sonkhol thu a tangtun na a hihi.   
\s1 Herod in Patangno te That

Herod kumpipa in, mipil te i theam hunlam a heak ciang, a thin\x - \xo 2:16 \xt \x*-uk mama a, mihing sawl in, mipil te in ama kungah phatak in a dok thu taw kisai in Bethlehem khua pan kipan a kim a pam a om patang kum ni le a nuai sia theampo that siat hi.
Kamsang Jeremiah i sonkhol na ah,

Ramah ngam pan in kaana aw te le nasiatak in tau na aw ki za hi, a tate a om ngawl hu in Rachel i kaana sia kuama in heneam zo ngawl hi, ci thu a tangtun na a hihi.   
\s1 Egypt Ngam Pan Nazareth  
\r Lk. 2:39, 40
Herod thi zawkciang, Egypt ngam a om Joseph mang sungah Topa vantungmi khat hong kilang a,
Tho in, nauno le a nu keng in Israel ngam ah paipui in: banghangziam cile nauno that nuam in a zong te thi siat zo hi, ci hi.
Joseph tho in, nauno le a nu Israel ngam ah paipui hi.

Ahihang Archelaus in a pa Herod zalai in Judah ngam uk hi, ci Joseph in a zak ciang tua ngam ah pai ngam ngawl hi: ahihang a mang sungah Pathian in kidop natu a son bang in, Joseph zong Galilee ngam ah kiheam hi.
Nazareth kici khua hong theng in tua khua ah om uh hi: tabang in kamsang i sonkholsa bang in, Nazareth khuami, kici tuh hi, a ci sia hong tangtung hi.

\s1 Tuiphumpa John  
\r Mk. 1:3-8; Jn. 1:19-28
Tua hun laitak in tuiphumpa John hong theng a, Judah ngam duisung ah thuhil hi,
John in, vantung kumpingam hong nai zo hi, na thinsung uh ki kheal in na mawna uh ki sikkik vun: ci hi.
Banghangziam cile hi thu sia, duisung ah a au mikhat i aw in, Topa pai na lampi pua vun, tangsak vun, ci kamsang Isaiah in John thu sonkhol zo hi.
John i puansil sia kala-uk mul taw ki tak a, savun khau taw a kawng hen hi; ama an sia khaumaw le ngam khuaitui a hihi.
Taciang Jerusalem pan ahizong, Judah ngam khua tatuam pan ahizong, Jordan ngun kiim theampo pan ahizong a kungah hongpai tek uh hi.
Amate mawna tek uh pualak in, Jordan ngun sungah tui ki phum uh hi.
Pharisee te le Sadducee te tui ki phum tu in hongpai John in a mu ciang in, maw no ngul suan te, hong theng pheang tu Pathian thin-ukna taisan tu in akua in kidop natu hong pia ziam?
Mawna pan ki sikkikna taw a kilawm nga pha te nga tavun:
Ka pa uh Abraham hi ci in na thin sungah ngaisun heak vun: banghangziam cile, Pathian in hi suangtum te Abraham suan le pal in vawt thei hi, ci kong son hi.
Tu in thingkung te bul ah heipui ki ngat zo hi: tua ahikom nga pha a nga ngawl thingkung sia phuk tu a, mei sungah bum hi.

Kei ka hile mawna ki sikkik na in tui kong phum hi: ahihang ka nung pan hongpai pa sia kei sang in vanglian zaw a, a peangdap toaisak tu zong ka kilawm bua hi: Ama in Tha Thiangtho le mei taw tuiphumna hong pia tuh hi:
A khut sungah tangkheaplaw toai in, tangzap tu hi, taang tang teng beamsung ah thun tu a, taangsi te sia a mit thei ngawl mei taw hal tu hi.

Tua laitak in Jesus sia Galilee pan Jordan ngun ah tui ki phum tu in John kungah hongpai hi.   
\s1 John in Jesus Tuiphumna Pia  
\r Lk. 3:21, 22; Jn. 1:31-34
Ahihang John in ama tho a, Keima sia nangma i nong tuiphum tu hizaw napi, kei kungah nang hongpai zaw ni ziam? ci hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in \wj Tu hile hibang hi phot hen, banghangziam cile thutang suana theampo a kicin kul hi, \wj* ci hi. Taciang John zong thukim hi.
Jesus tui a kiphum zawk pociang tui sung pan hong pusuak to hi: taciang en vun, van ki hong in, Pathian Thaa sia vakhu bang hong tuaksuk in a tungah a tawl nga, John in mu hi:
Taciang van pan in aw khat in, Hisia in ka it ka Tapa a hihi, ama tungah ka lungkim hi, ci hi.
Tuazawkciang doaimangpa i ze-etna thuak tu in Thaa in duisung ah paipui hi.
Sun sawm li le zan sawm li an a tan zawkciang, Jesus a ngilkial hi.
Tasia ciang ze-et tu pa hongpai a, Pathian Tapa na hile, suang hite anluum suak tu in thupia in, ci hi.
Ahihang Jesus in, \wj Mihingte sia anluum bek taw hi ngawl in, Pathian kam pan a pusuak kammal taw nungta hi, ci in ki at hi, \wj* ci in zo kik hi.
Tuazawkciang doaimangpa in Jesus sia khuapi thiangtho ah paipui a, biakinn khuvum ah a domto zawkciang,
Pathian Tapa na hile nangma le nangma ki khiasuk in, banghangziam cile Pathian in a khut taw hong dom tu in vantungmi te thupia tu a, na peang suang taw ki khen ngawl tu hi, ci ki at hi, ci hi.
Jesus in, \wj Na Topa Pathian na ze et heak in, ci zong ki at thua hi, \wj* ci in zo kik hi.
Tuazawkciang doaimangpa in mualsang mama tungah Jesus paipui in, leitung kumpingam theampo le vangletna te lak a,
Ka mai ah kun in nong bia le, hi teng theampo kong pia tu hi, ci hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in, \wj Satan awng, tai in: banghangziam cile, Topa na Pathian bek bia in a, Ama na bek seam in, ci in ki at hi, \wj* ci hi.

Tasiaciang doaimangpa sia Jesus kung pan in tai a, vantungmi te hongpai in Jesus ou uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus Nasep Ki Pan  
\r Mk. 1:14; Lk. 4:14, 15
John thongtak hi, ci thu Jesus in a zakciang in, Galilee ah pai hi;
Nazareth khua nusia in, Capernaum ah om tu in pai hi, tua khua sia Zebulun le Naphtali ngamngi, tuipi hui ah a om khua a hihi.
Hibang teng sia kamsang Isaiah i sonkholsa,
Zebulun ngam le Naphtali ngam, Jordan ngun ngal tuipi pai na lam hui, Gentile mite omna mun Galilee;
Khuazing sungah a teang mihingte in, a lian mama khuavak mu tu a, thina lim nuai ah a omte tungah khuavak tang tu hi, ci thu a tangtun na a hihi.

Tua hun pan kipan Jesus in, \wj Na mawna ki sikkik vun: banghangziam cile vantung kumpingam hong nai zo hi, \wj* ci in thuhil kipan hi.   
\s1 Nungzui Masa te a Sapna  
\r Mak. 1:16-20; Luk. 5:2-11
Jesus Galilee hui ah a va laitak in ngasa man te u nau ni, tui sungah ngen a pai laitak mu hi, tua u nau ni te sia Peter a kici Simon le a nau Andrew te a hihi.
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Hong zui tavun, mihing mante kong suaksak tu hi, \wj* ci hi.
Tasia pociang amate in a ngen te nusia uh a, ama zui pai uh hi.
Tua mun pan a paisuak uh ciang, Zebedee tapa te ni James le John te u nau mu hi, amate sia a pa taw ngunkuang sungah a ngente a phaw laitak hi a; Jesus in amate sam hi.

Tasia pociang a ngunkuang le a pa nusia in zui pai hi.   
\s1 Jesus in Mi Tam Mama Damsak  
\r Mk. 1:29-34; Lk. 6:17-19
Jesus Galilee ngamsung theampo ah vak in, amate synagogue tatuam te ah thuhil a, kumpingam lungdamna thu son kawm in natna tatuam a thuak cina te damsak siat hi.
Syria ngamsung theampo ah a minthang mama a: natna le ngimna namcin a thuak cina theampo ahizong, doai vei te, butthi thei te le langngaw te damsak siat hi.
Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judah le Jordah ngunngal pan mihon tampi te in Ama zui uh hi.

\s1 Mualtung Thuhilna  
\r Lk. 6:20-49
Tua mihonpi te Jesus in a mu ciang in mualtung ah kato hi: a tosuk zawkciang, a nungzui te a kungah hongpai uh hi:
Taciang a kam hong in, amate thuhil a,
\wj Thaa thu ah a zawngkhal te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile vantung ki ukna sia amate a, a hihi.\wj*
\wj Thum le tau in a kap te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate in henepna nga tu hi.\wj*
\wj Mi nunneam te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate in leitung ngamh lua tu uh hi.\wj*
\wj Thutang suana an du tui du bang in a du te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate a ngilva kik tu hi.\wj*
\wj Hesuakna neite thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate hesuakna ma sangkik tu hi.\wj*
\wj Thin sung thiangtho te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate in Pathian mu tu hi.\wj*
\wj Kilemna a vawt te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile amate Pathian tate kici tu hi.\wj*
\wj Thutang suana hang in vawtsiatna a thuak te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile vantung ngam sia amate a, a hihi.\wj*
\wj Keima hang in ngual in mawsiatna taw hong vawtsia a, leilot thu a tatuam a son ciang in, thuphatoai na hi uh hi.\wj*

\wj Lungdam vun a, angtang vun, banghangziam cile vantung ah na thaman uh lian mama hi: banghangziam cile note mai ah kamsang te zong tabangma in vawtsia ngei uh hi.\wj*   
\s1 Ci le Khuavak  
\r Mk. 4:21-23; Mk. 9:50; Lk. 8:16-18; Lk. 14:34, 35
\wj Note sia leitung i ci na hi uh hi: ahihang ci sia a al na a om nawn bale, bangbang in al kik thei tu ziam? doipua ah vawk in peangtaw siicil tu simngawl bangma phatuam ngawl hi.\wj*
\wj Note sia leitung i khuavak na hi uh hi. Mualdawn ah a kisa khuapi sia kilia thei ngeingawl hi.\wj*
\wj Kuama in khuaimei a det ciang khum taw khup ngei ngawl hi, meidetna munsang na ah suan in de hi; taciang tua meivang in innsung theampo tangsak hi.\wj*

\wj Na khuavak uh midang te muna ah tang tahen, tabang in amate in a pha na vawt te mu tu a, van ah a om na Pa pokna pia tu uh hi.\wj*   
\s1 Thukham Hilna
\wj Keima sia thukham le kamsang te thu siatsua tu in hongpai hi, ci in ngaisun heak vun: siatsua tu in hongpai ngawl khi hi, a kicingsak tu in hongpai zaw khi hi.\wj*
\wj Amantak kong son hi, van le lei a bo zong thukham sung pan a nobel bawkno khat zong khuangkhim ngawl in bo thong ngawl tu hi.\wj*

\wj Tua ahikom, a kuamapo in, thupiak te sung pan a nobel khat pealkhial in, ngualdang thu a hil le, vantung kumpingam sungah a nobel hi kici tu hi: ahizong in a kuamapo in thupiakte seam a, ngualdang zong a hil le, vantung kumpingam sungah lian hi, kici tu hi.\wj*

\wj Banghangziam cile, thukhamhil te le Pharisee te na dem zo bua u le, vantung kumpingam sungah tum thei ngawl tu nu hi, ci in kong son hi.\wj*   
\s1 Tualthat Thu
\wj Nidanglai in, tualthat heak in; tualthat te thukhenna thuak tu kilawm hi, ci thu na zazo uh hi.\wj*

\wj Ahihang keima in hibang in kong ci hi, a kuamapo matlap nei ngawl in a suapui te tungah a thin-uk peuma, thukhenna thuak tu hi: taciang a kuamapo in, a suapui a zawngsak sia zong thukhen upa te kung puak tu kilawm hi: a kuamapo in, a suapuipa mi ngoai a ci peuma, hell sung a theng tu kilawm hi.\wj*
\wj Tua ahikom biaktau tungah piak tu na ken ciang in, na suapui khatpo i hong mawsiatna khatpo na phawk le, \wj*
\wj Na piaktu sia biaktau mai ah nusia phot in a, na suapuipa kungah pai masa in; kilemna na vawt zawkciang, biakpiakna pia kik pheang in.\wj*

\wj Khatpo in thu hong vawt a hile, zumkong na thetma in, lamkallak ah manlang in ama taw thukimna vawt pak in; tabang a hibale, thukhen te kung hong ap tu a, thukhen te in palik te hong ap in, palik te in thonginn ah hong khia tu hi.\wj*

\wj A mantak kong ci ciang, liausum na piak siat mateng thonginn sung pan na suakta thei batu hi.\wj*   
\s1 Palngul Mawna  
\r Mat. 19:1-12; Mk. 10:1-12; Lk. 16:18
\wj Nidang in palngul mawna vawtheak in, ci sia na zaksa uh a hihi:\wj*
\wj Ahizong tu in, khatpo in numei khat khialpui nopna thin taw a en a hile, a thin sung pan tua nu taw khial zo hi.\wj*
\wj Na ziatsang mit in hong khialsak a hile, khelkeak in vawk in: na pumpi vekpi taw hell sungah na ki khiak tu sang in pumpi khen khat na sup tu phazaw hi.\wj*

\wj Na ziatsang khut in hong khialsak le, tan in vawk in: na pumpi vekpi taw hell sungah na ki khiak tu sang in pumpi khen khat na sup tu phazaw hi.\wj*   
\s1 Nupa Kikhenna Thu
\wj Khat po in a zi a khul nuam a hile, khulna lai pia tahen, kici hi:\wj*
\wj Ahihang keima in, khatpo in paktatna thu simngawl a zi a khul le, a zi sia palngul mawna vawt suaksak hi, taciang tua a ki khul numei a tenpui kik pa zong, palngul mawna vawt ma hi veve hi.\wj*
\wj Nidang in, kamciam pia heak in, ahihang Topa kungah na kiciamna te tangtun in, ci thu na zazo uh hi:\wj*
\wj Ahihang kei ka hile hibang kong ci hi, kiciamna vawt lilim heak in; van sam in kiciam heak in; banghangziam cile Pathian kumpi tokhum a hihi:\wj*
\wj Lei sam in kiciam heak in; banghangziam cile Pathian i peang ngakna mun hi: Jerusalem sam in zong kiciam heak in; banghangziam cile a lian kumpipa omna mun khuapi a hihi.\wj*
\wj Na lu sam in zong kiciam heak in, banghangziam cile na samzamno khat vomsak le kangsak thei ngawl ni hi.\wj*

\wj Ahihang, ngualdang taw na ki paupui ciang in, A “hi” te ‘hi'; a “hi ngawl” te “hi ngawl” ma ci vun: banghangziam cile hi teng zawkciang sia pha nawn ngawl hi.\wj*   
\s1 Thukkikna Thu  
\r Lk. 6:27-36
\wj Mittang khat luang in mit tang khat, ha tang khat luang in ha tang khat, ci thu na zaksa uh a hihi:\wj*
\wj Ahihang kei hibang in kong ci hi, siatna te na khak heak vun: khatpo in na ziatsang biang hong beang le, na veisang biang zong daw vet lai in.\wj*
\wj Khatpo in na puansil dei in thu hong vawt le, na tungsil zong pia vet in.\wj*
\wj Nang hong zawthawkvawt khatpo in tai khat hongpaisak le, tai ni dong paipui vet in.\wj*

\wj Van hong ngen te pia in, ciang hong pu nuam te zong nial heak in.\wj*   
\s1 Ngalte Itna  
\r Lk. 6:29, 30
\wj Ahihang kei kong cina pan, na ngal te uh it vun a, no hong hamsiat te thupha pia vun, no hong ensan te atu thungetsak vun;\wj*
\wj Tabang in vantung a om na Pa uh i tate na hi tu uh hi: banghangziam cile Ama in misia le mipha te tungah ni suaksak a, thuman le thuman ngawl te tungah ngua zusak hi.\wj*
\wj Banghangziam cile no hong it te bek na it uh le, bang thaman a om ziam? siadong te nangawn zong in tabangma seam hi ngawl ziam?\wj*
\wj Na suapui te bek na paupui uh le, ngualdang taw bang ki lamdang nu ziam? siadong te zong tabangma vawt hi ngawl ziam?\wj*
\wj Vantung a na Pa uh cialcing ahi bangma in, note zong na cialcing ta vun, ci hi.\wj*
\s1 Ngual Mu na ah Phatna
\wj Mizawng te hu na na piak uh ciang in ngual mai ah na vawt thak tu kidawm vun, tabang in ngual mu na ah na vawt uh le vantung a om na Pa uh kung pan in thaman bangma nga ngawl tu nu hi.\wj*

\wj Tua ahikom, mizawng te hu na na piak uh ciang in, a ki hitheamsak te in ngual pok tu thangai in synagogue sung le lampi dung teng ah a vawt bang in, na mai uh pan lemle tum in vawt heak vun. Amantak kong ci ciang, amate thaman a sang hi zo uh hi. \wj*
\wj Ahihang mizawng te hu na na piak ciang in, na ziatsang khut i sep sia, na veisang khut in he heak tahen: \wj*

\wj Kuama heak ngawl in mizawng te na hu na, thuku a mu na Pa in thaman a kilangtak in hong pia tu hi. \wj*   
\s1 Thungetna Thu  
\r Lk. 11:1-4

\wj Thu na nget ciang in a ki hitheamsak te bang in ngen heak in: banghangziam cile amate sia synagogue sung le lamkabom ah ding in, ngual i mu thei tu in thungen nuam sap si. Amantak in kong ci ciang, amate in thaman nga zo uh hi. \wj*

\wj Ahihang, thu na nget ciang in, na inndoi sungah tum in a, kongkha na kha zawkciang, a ki mu ngawl na mun ah a om na Pa kungah thungen in; taciang thuku a mu na Pa in a kilangtak in thaman hong pia tu hi. \wj*

\wj Ahizong, thu na nget ciang in Pathian nei ngawl te in matlap nei ngawl a thuap kikik bang in ngen heak vun: banghangziam cile amate in tam tatak ngen bialbual le Pathian in za tuansap tu in um uh hi.\wj*
\wj Amate bang hi heak vun: na kisapna uh na nget uh ma in, na Pa uh in he siat zo hi.\wj*
\wj Tua ahiciang, hibang in thu ngen vun: vantung a om kote Pa awng, na min thiangtho ki upat tahen.\wj*
\wj Na kumpingam hong piang tahen. Vantung ah na deina a kicin bang in, leitung ah kicing tahen.\wj*
\wj Tu ni in ka nisim an uh hong pia ta in.\wj*
\wj Ngual dang mawna ka maisak uh bangma, kote mawna zong hong maisak ta in.\wj*
\wj Ze-etna sungah hong paipui ngawl in, phatngawlna sung pan in hong tankhia tan: ukzawkna, vangletna le minthanna a tawntung in nangma a, a hihi. Amen. \wj*
